public_statements.speaker: Lily

public_statements.speaker: Luke

public_statements.speaker: Mike
public_statements.text: Luke, you called it right — Lily's luck finally ran out.

public_statements.speaker: Lily
public_statements.text: Luke, you finally caught me — but the bullet had your name on it. That's the bar's cruel math.

public_statements.speaker: Mike

public_statements.speaker: Mike

public_statements.speaker: Lily
public_statements.text: Four Aces from one hand? The bar remembers, Mike — and so do I.
